	"fmt"
	"github.com/cloudwego/kitex/transport"

	// Analyze test expectations

	fmt.Println("  After GRPC:", transport.GRPC)

	fmt.Println("Composition tests:")
	fmt.Println("  TTHeaderFramed =", transport.TTHeaderFramed, "=", transport.TTHeader|transport.Framed)

	fmt.Println("Individual protocols:")
	fmt.Println("  PurePayload =", transport.PurePayload)
	fmt.Println("  Framed =", transport.Framed)
	fmt.Println("  TTHeader =", transport.TTHeader)
	fmt.Println("  GRPC =", transport.GRPC)
	fmt.Println("  HTTP =", transport.HTTP)
}
EOF

call_args.script:
cd /app && cat > /tmp/test_protocol_logic.go << 'EOF'
package main
import (
	"fmt"
	"github.com/cloudwego/kitex/pkg/rpcinfo"
	"github.com/cloudwego/kitex/transport"
)
func main() {
	fmt.Println("Test 1: New config should have Framed default")
	c1 := rpcinfo.NewRPCConfig()
	fmt.Printf("  Initial: %v (expected: Framed)\n", c1.TransportProtocol())
	fmt.Printf("  Match: %v\n\n", c1.TransportProtocol() == transport.Framed)
	
	fmt.Println("Test 2: Setting HTTP should replace Framed")
	c2 := rpcinfo.NewRPCConfig()
	rpcinfo.AsMutableRPCConfig(c2).SetTransportProtocol(transport.HTTP)
	fmt.Printf("  After HTTP: %v (expected: HTTP)\n", c2.TransportProtocol())
	fmt.Printf("  Match: %v\n\n", c2.TransportProtocol() == transport.HTTP)
	
	fmt.Println("Test 3: Setting TTHeader should compose with Framed")
	c3 := rpcinfo.NewRPCConfig()
	rpcinfo.AsMutableRPCConfig(c3).SetTransportProtocol(transport.TTHeader)
	fmt.Printf("  After TTHeader: %v (expected: TTHeader|Framed)\n", c3.TransportProtocol())
	fmt.Printf("  Has both: %v\n\n", c3.TransportProtocol()&transport.TTHeaderFramed == transport.TTHeaderFramed)
	
	fmt.Println("Test 4: Setting GRPC should compose with Framed")
	c4 := rpcinfo.NewRPCConfig()
	rpcinfo.AsMutableRPCConfig(c4).SetTransportProtocol(transport.GRPC)
	fmt.Printf("  After GRPC: %v\n", c4.TransportProtocol())
	fmt.Printf("  Has GRPC: %v, Has Framed: %v\n\n", 
		c4.TransportProtocol()&transport.GRPC != 0,
		c4.TransportProtocol()&transport.Framed != 0)
}
EOF
go run /tmp/test_protocol_logic.go 2>&1
